main_measure.name: OLS slope of 336-bar forward return minus coin drift on forecast (grid bars with forecast > 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 (with top-tercile mean excess > 0 and >= 100 cases); reject if t <= -2 (>= 100 cases)

supporting_check.name: top-tercile (by forecast) mean 336-bar excess return over drift > 0

decided_by: Slope t is 2 or more, the top-tercile mean excess return is above 0, with at least 100 cases.
reading: The regression pools all coins' grid bars with forecast > 0 (grid from each window's first row, returns inside the window), the drift is each coin's mean 336-bar return over all its windows' grid bars, and the top tercile is the top third of those bars ranked by forecast (ties broken by order).

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
